WorkspaceState.title: WorkspaceState
WorkspaceState.description: Cloud-synced AWD Master tobacco inventory, serials, rolls, packaging, and factories owned by a single authenticated Google user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

rawTobaccos.description: Array of raw tobacco stock items.

finishedBatches.description: Array of finished tobacco serial items.

rollSamples.description: Array of tobacco roll archive samples.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last cloud sync.

WorkspaceChunk.title: WorkspaceChunk
WorkspaceChunk.description: Overflow chunk document storing up to 250 raw tobacco or finished batch items so workspaces scale beyond 10,000 items without hitting Firestore's 1MB document limit.

/workspaces/{userId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced workspace document keyed by the user's Firebase Auth UID.

/workspaces/{userId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Overflow chunks for rawTobaccos and finishedBatches when inventory exceeds 250 items.
